# Academic structure contract

<!-- bp-vault-skills:start -->
- Root boundary: this fixture only.
- Language: Spanish.
- Class notes: `Clases/` with the existing `kind: clase` property.
- Practices: `Practicas/`.
- Evaluations: `Evaluaciones/`.
- Links: local wikilinks. Cross-subject links are allowed only when the concepts truly relate.
- Developed maps to existing `estado: desarrollada`. Learned has no property mapping.
- Mechanical edits: formatting and unambiguous broken links.
- Approval: semantic changes, property additions, note creation, splits, moves, and renames require a preview and explicit approval.
<!-- bp-vault-skills:end -->
